args.title: Juniper Labware Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost driver for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs reduce handling costs by about 20%, offering a clear efficiency lever.
- Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of their original margin, underscoring the value of speed in the returns-to-resale pipeline.
